item.description: International Journal of Engineering — The growing challenges posed by rapid urbanization and increased vehicle density have highlighted the need for precise and privacy-preserving traffic flow prediction models. item.description: International Journal of Technology in Education and Science — This research addresses the systemic educational inequality in Thailand, where a severe shortage of physical science laboratories in rural areas hinders the development of 21st-century scientific literacy. item.description: GeoJournal of Tourism and Geosites — Accurate delineation of agricultural field boundaries is essential for agro-production monitoring, irrigation management, and sustainable land use planning. item.description: Ved International Journal of Arts Commerce and Technology (VIJACT) — Migration of rural youth to cities has turned out to be a big developmental problem in a lot of countries particularly in developing ones. item.description: Lecture notes in mobility — Despite the growing implementation of road pricing schemes globally, public acceptance remains a significant barrier.
